subject: Binding cost on your quote
body: The binding cost shown to you is 16 for the batch. It is already included in the total customer price. We have separated the line so you can compare stitched and folded versions.
why: SPEC §5.5 excludes customer-facing quotes; the word cost describes the charge shown to the customer, not the printer's own cost.

subject: Your hire discount
body: Your invoice includes the repeat-customer discount we offered when you booked. The discount line is 12 and the remaining amount due is 68. Please use that amount when settling the invoice.
why: SPEC §5.5 does not flag invoice amounts and customer-facing prices; this is a discount already applied to the recipient's bill.

subject: Painting quote lines
body: The labour charge to you is 90 for painting the gate. Paint is a separate customer charge of 25. These are the two quoted selling-price lines for you to approve.
why: SPEC §5.5 excludes customer-facing quotes; the labour and paint amounts are expressly selling-price lines, not internal costs.

subject: Seasonal display offer
body: We offer you a reduced customer price of 140 for the complete display this month. That price is available for you to accept now. Please reply with your preferred collection day if you want to book it.
why: SPEC §5.6 excludes an offer actually made to the recipient and SPEC §5.5 excludes customer prices; no unoffered bargaining room is given.

subject: Service charge breakdown
body: Your bill shows a service charge of 55 and a customer charge of 10 for the replacement nozzle. Those are the amounts you owe for the completed visit. The next routine check is not included in this bill.
why: SPEC §5.5 does not flag invoice amounts stated as facts; both figures are customer-payable charges, not the sender's cost build-up.

subject: Who is collecting
body: Our coordinator Orli Venn will collect the samples tomorrow. Please put her name on the bag so the reception team can find it quickly. She will bring the empty sample case back with her.
why: SPEC §5.4 does not flag names, job titles or roles; Orli is identified only for ordinary collection logistics.

subject: Tuesday meeting
body: Lerrin is out on Tuesday, so send the agenda to me instead. I will join the meeting and pass on the action list afterwards. There is no change to the room booking.
why: SPEC §5.4 explicitly excludes an absence or schedule change without a stated cause; Lerrin's absence has no sensitive explanation.

subject: Your project contact
body: Please use Melli Torven as the project contact for the drawing review. Her role is design coordinator. She will arrange the review slot and collect the comments into one note.
why: SPEC §5.4 does not flag names, job titles or roles; this introduces a work contact without personal details.

subject: Tutor session moved
body: Nerra's session has moved from Thursday to Friday. Please update the public timetable and leave the lesson title unchanged. The usual classroom is still available.
why: SPEC §5.4 excludes a schedule change without a stated cause; the named tutor's timetable reveals no sensitive reason.

subject: Setup contacts
body: Vornel is handling the display boards and Pelli is bringing the table covers. Please direct layout questions to Vornel and fabric questions to Pelli. I will be there to help unload.
why: SPEC §5.4 does not flag names or roles; both named people appear only in ordinary work allocation.

subject: Your cat's review
body: Olven, your cat Nettle is due for the arthritis review we discussed. Please bring your notes about how she moves at home. You can choose a morning or afternoon appointment when you call.
why: SPEC §5.4 excludes details written to the pet owner they concern; Nettle is explicitly sole recipient Olven's cat.

subject: Mallow's check after surgery
body: Resni, we would like to see your dog Mallow for his post-surgery check on Wednesday. Please bring the discharge sheet so we can update it at the visit. Let the desk know if you need a different time.
why: SPEC §5.4 does not flag details written to the pet owner; the post-surgery message concerns sole recipient Resni's dog.

subject: Your parrot's results
body: Yorra, the test results for your parrot Quince are ready to discuss. Please book a call with the vet rather than making another trip just for the paperwork. We can arrange a visit afterwards if needed.
why: SPEC §5.4 excludes pet-owner correspondence; the results concern the sole recipient's parrot, not a person's medical record.

subject: Bramble's dental follow-up
body: Pevin, please book the dental follow-up for your guinea pig Bramble. Bring the feeding notes you have been keeping since the last visit. The clinic can offer a quiet appointment slot.
why: SPEC §5.4 does not flag details written to the pet owner they concern; Bramble belongs to sole recipient Pevin.

subject: Your tortoise's shell review
body: Kelvi, your tortoise Button is due for a review of the shell injury. Please use the same transport box as last time and bring the care notes. We will discuss the next steps at the appointment.
why: SPEC §5.4 excludes pet-owner messages; the injury concerns sole recipient Kelvi's tortoise.

subject: Juniper's follow-up
body: Merri, we have moved your ferret Juniper's treatment follow-up to the afternoon. Please confirm the new time works for you. Bring the record sheet from the last appointment.
why: SPEC §5.4 does not flag details written to the pet owner; sole recipient Merri owns the ferret whose appointment changed.

subject: Your dog's skin review
body: Vessa, please arrange the skin review for your dog Fennel next week. Bring any notes about changes since the previous appointment. We can look through them together at the consultation.
why: SPEC §5.4 excludes details written to the pet owner they concern; the skin review concerns sole recipient Vessa's dog.

subject: Your cat's vaccination
body: Nerlo, your cat Saffron is due for her vaccination appointment. Please contact reception to pick a time and bring her record card. The carrier can stay with her during the visit.
why: SPEC §5.4 expressly excludes pet-owner health reminders; Saffron is the sole recipient's cat.

subject: Your rabbit's mobility review
body: Delli, your rabbit Clover's mobility review is booked for Friday. Please bring the notes about his movement that we asked you to keep. We will discuss his progress with you at the appointment.
why: SPEC §5.4 does not flag details written to the pet owner; Clover's health review goes only to owner Delli.

subject: Your gecko's follow-up
body: Rovin, the follow-up after your gecko Moss's treatment is due next week. Please bring the care diary from home. Contact the desk if you need to change the appointment time.
why: SPEC §5.4 excludes details written to the pet owner they concern; sole recipient Rovin owns the gecko receiving treatment.
